title: Legacy open + secured — retro gear forever welcome
motto: Bring Truth DNS and Field DHCP fully up — legacy ears open, gatekeeper secured, Dreamcast modem welcome

dialup.note: Null-modem or USB voice modem — queen runs pppd peer; Dreamcast dials in

bba.note: Broadband Adapter on retro LAN — DHCP option 6 → Truth Resolver

retro_ports.note: PSO / ChuChu Rocket / retro tunnel ports — auto-allow through civilian passthrough

protocol_bridge.title: Sovereign protocol bridge
protocol_bridge.motto: Own wire first. Legacy ears open through gatekeeper — never raw guest egress.

touch_policy.motto: A human should never feel a touch if it is a safe signal. Music, normal car traffic, animals, and Train are different.

gatekeeper.heaven_hell_motto: We know Heaven from Hell. To those who chose Hell, we also choose it for them. No mercy. No friendly fire. God Bless.
gatekeeper.know_doctrine: Know that nothing is unseen and nothing is fully secure. We can't hide all the rocks, so send Hell to Hell.
gatekeeper.why_no_auto_block: Packet permission v4.0: DPI + gatekeeper know who and intent on every flow. Good traffic (74 flow(s)) passes at zero nft cost. Only harmful sections get segment blocks; harm candidates get IP blocks.
